quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities
rationale: Audit rights are asymmetric — Vendor may audit Customer but Customer has no audit/assurance rights; §23 heading is empty and should be populated with SOC 2, security assessment, and invoice audit rights.

quote: governed by the laws of the State of New York
rationale: Review raises no objection to New York law and venue.

quote: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer
rationale: MFN favours Customer but is unenforceable as drafted: no definition of "similarly situated" and no audit/true-up remedy.

quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies.
rationale: No minimum commitment; review raises no issue.
ruleTitle: Minimum purchase commitments and volume restrictions on Customer

quote: hiring any person who responds to general recruitment

rationale: Auto-renewal with 30-day window; email alone insufficient for notice — calendar deadlines and permit acknowledged email.

quote: provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form
rationale: Rates may not exist; export only on request; no self-service export or insolvency escrow trigger, leaving data stranded on §9.2 termination.

quote: will not contain malicious code intentionally introduced by Vendor
rationale: Malicious-code warranty too narrow and §19.4 repair period is open-ended ("reasonable period") without an outer limit.

quote: professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000
rationale: E&O limit light for a hosted platform; cancellation notice only "to the extent available"; no additional insured, waiver of subrogation, or extended reporting period.
